The '''raptor''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] species, a variant of the [[tonitran]] lizard found on [[Makeb]]. Born and bred for war, Raptors could be trained by an expert creature handler for use as riding animals.<ref name="TOR" /> Raptors could be found on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]<ref>{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=flashpoint|Blood Hunt}}</ref> as well as [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=uprising|Landing Party}}</ref>
